Tap Check for updates to begin. After the download and verification finish, Android opens its installation screen. If required, allow Jeemi to install apps in system settings and return to continue. Installation still requires your confirmation.

Downloads use network data. Checking only happens after you tap the button; leaving the home page or putting Jeemi in the background cancels an unfinished check or download. No update is installed silently and older versions are not installed. APK size, SHA-256, package name, version, architecture and signing identity are checked. Cancelling system authorization or installation keeps the downloaded APK available for retry. Official releases update official builds signed with the same key; development builds cannot be overwritten. Android may restart the app and interrupt VPN during installation.
